capabilities: Display ZIP entry metadata as a folder/file tree and table
Filter entries by path text or extension
Summarize archive counts, sizes, and compression ratio
Flag unsafe entries such as path traversal, encryption, or huge sizes
Refresh metadata after external file changes
disambiguation: Not an archiver, extractor, backup, or export tool; it only reads ZIP metadata and never extracts, opens, renames, deletes, or writes files.
extras: v0.1 supports .zip only; .tar, .gz, .tgz, .rar, and .7z are explicitly deferred. Listings are capped at 2,000 entries. No parser dependency, network, clipboard, subprocess, or write-back APIs. BRAT install offered for beta testing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see what is inside a .zip file in the vault without extracting it or opening it in another app.
